(Currently amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles__, and wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 μm in size__.
